newsitem.title: INDIA: Crisil lowers India PAL-Peugeot's bond rating.
newsitem.headline: Crisil lowers India PAL-Peugeot's bond rating.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Tuesday it lowered its rating for a 1.42 billion rupee debenture issue of Indian auto maker PAL-Peugeot to "BBB with rating watch" from "A-."
"The revised rating indicates that the instrument offers sufficient safety of timely payment of interest and principal," Crisil said in a statement.
"The rating watch is due to the uncertainty regarding the modalities and timing of the proposed inflow of funds into the company from Automobiles Peugeot," it added.
It said the company's project was hit by a delay in the inflow of public funds and the devolvement of its partly convertible debenture issue.
Labour problems also contributed to the company's problems, Crisil said.
PAL-Peugeot is a joint venture of Indian auto firm Premier Automobiles Ltd and French firm Automobiles Peugeot .
